scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/main.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test:cluster: npm run test:cluster:products && npm run test:cluster:orders
scripts.test:cluster:products: esbuild test/cluster/products.cluster.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/products.cluster.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node dist/products.cluster.mjs
scripts.test:cluster:orders: esbuild test/cluster/orders.cluster.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/orders.cluster.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node dist/orders.cluster.mjs
